title: Mike Macdonald: Jaxon Smith-Njigba a "foundational piece" of who we want to be

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: Jaxon Smith-Njigba a "foundational piece" of who we want to be
sources.description: Seahawks General Manager John Schneider said on Wednesday that he felt the team was "blessed" when wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba fell to them with the 20th overall pick in 2023 and the feeling hasn't changed over the three years.
